evidence.mechanism: shot-08s: undyed bands sweep in from the lower-left end and stack along one fixed diagonal, each new band shoving the earlier ones; by shot-20s the cloth has folded into a mirrored V with the same banding.
evidence.ambition: shot-08s: a paper drop-shadow, warped band coordinates and a mirror fold make the cloth read as fabric; by shot-20s a chevron fold adds a second geometric act, though only one flat banded layer is visible.
evidence.craft: shot-20s: a moire shimmer runs through the V's central fold where band pitch aliases, and the shot-02s stripes wobble at the edges; the indigo-on-cream palette and soft shadow stay clean.
evidence.distinctness: shot-02s: indigo cloth bands on a pale cream ground; the recent sand grid is apricot and vermilion and the Penrose is ochre and rust, so this textile subject and palette read apart.
evidence.polish: shot-02s: a diagonal rectangle sits slightly off-centre with bands starting at its lower-left; by shot-20s the piece resolves into a symmetric V, so start and end frames are clearly different and settled.

pairwise_justification: The median sand grid fills the frame with apricot branching fronts and vermilion scars; tonight's shot-02s and shot-08s show one indigo rectangle on flat cream, so the median reads richer in a head-to-head thumbnail.

critique.change: Remove the moire at shot-20s: where the V's central fold shimmers, lower the band frequency near the fold or low-pass the warp so the bands resolve cleanly at full 1280x720 size.

Make shot-20s show the settled diagonal rectangle the storyboard promises instead of only a mirrored V, so the final frame keeps the wrap rule visible and the dense-to-sparse pitch drift shows across the cloth.
Add a second rendering act: a visible thread line wrapping diagonally across the cloth with self-shadow in the pleats, so the gathering reads as material rather than one flat banded layer.
